high_level_description: The image is a promotional post for the film "Dead Man's Wire," directed by Gus Van Sant. The post announces the North American premiere of the film at TIFF50 (Toronto International Film Festival 2023). It lists the main cast members: Bill Skarsgård, Dacre Montgomery, Colman Domingo, Myha’la, and Al Pacino. The text also provides a brief description of the film, stating that it depicts the 1977 kidnapping by Tony Kiritsis of his bank mortgager. The image within the post shows a scene from the film.
